_note: Operator-facing maturity overlay for shipped Libro skills. Profile membership is NOT stored here; it is derived from manifests/ at generation time (single source of truth). This file only adds the status + summary that manifests lack. Regenerate SKILL_STATUS.md via scripts/skill-status.sh after editing.

_status_legend.stable: Dogfooded by Cerebro in daily flow. Safe to rely on.
_status_legend.preview: Shipped + functional, but not yet dogfooded daily. Behavior may change. Ship-what-we-use posture: returning to stable as daily-flow integration lands.
_status_legend.experimental: Early. May break or be removed. Try it, do not depend on it.
_status_legend.retired: Retired upstream. Shipped for reference and so existing setups keep working; its scripts refuse billable runs unless you opt in. Do not build new work on it.

brain-setup.summary: Scaffolds the Brain folder hierarchy (sessions / decisions / dashboard / awareness).

sessionstart.summary: Opens a session with a grounded department brief (single-shot orientation).

sessionend.summary: Closes a session with a structured retro, dashboard update, and memory-size probe.

ceo-brief.summary: Cross-department rollup synthesizing the latest session state per department.

cerebro-doctor.summary: Health probe for the installed bundle: skills, scaffold integrity, dependencies.

memory-attribution-lint.summary: Enforces the 11-key provenance frontmatter contract on memory files.

skill-manage.summary: 6-action CLI over your skill library (create / edit / patch / delete / write-file / remove-file).

daily-brief.summary: Reads one source you choose and returns a short ranked brief. Single SKILL.md, no scripts.

decision.summary: Takes a yes/no question plus facts and returns a verdict with its reason. Single SKILL.md, no scripts.

memory-recall.summary: Reads your Brain (sessions, decisions, awareness) and recaps what you did and what is open. Read-only, fully local.

advisor-mode.summary: Tiered model routing. LEGACY since 2026-07-26: the tier heuristic in its SKILL.md is the durable part; scripts need LIBRO_LEGACY_OPTIN=1 to make live calls.

council-mode.summary: Adversarial parallel comparison. LEGACY since 2026-07-26: kept for reference; scripts need LIBRO_LEGACY_OPTIN=1 to make live calls.

orchestrator-mode.summary: Sequential chain routing across stages. LEGACY since 2026-07-26: kept for reference; scripts need LIBRO_LEGACY_OPTIN=1 to make live calls.
